# P1 — Pre-Appointment 1
# Walk into your appointment with a file ready.

## Project
P1 is a mobile app (Android, iOS coming) that captures what happens between doctor visits — pain levels, photos, temperature, notes — and compiles it into a clear one-page physician briefing.

## Key Features
- 3D body map to mark pain locations (23 body regions, front/back)
- 2-minute daily check-ins: pain gauge, temperature, photo with ghost overlay
- Gemini-powered AI micro-reports and trend detection
- One-page PDF physician briefing with charts, photos, questions
- Privacy-first architecture with self-deployable backend
- Works offline, syncs when online

## Tech Stack
- Android: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose
- iOS: SwiftUI
- Backend: Go + PostgreSQL (Cloud Run)
- Website: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS (Cloudflare Pages)
- AI: Google Gemini

## Status
v1.0.14 on Google Play. iOS in development. Hackathon project for XPRIZE Gemini. MVP phase.
